entries.title: Your crew on iPhone and iPad
entries.body: The first mate gains the computer's reactions and fidgets. Swipe through each computer's group, tap a crewmate to preview their work, and open the existing task record. Animation follows the display's permitted rate instead of a fixed 30-frame schedule.

picture.alt: Infinitary's native scene with the first mate, orbiting crewmates, branching program work and another computer's formation
